newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 21.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Foot and mouth disease plagues Taiwan's hog population, estimated to lose T$160 billion
-- President Lee Teng-hui says Nationalist Party impossible to buy votes during elections
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Foot and mouth disease rocks Taiwan; 10 counties declared infected area, pork exports banned
-- U.S. House leader Gingrich to visit Taiwan on April 2
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan declared foot and mouth disease-infected area, hog prices plunge sharply
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Premier Lien Chan orders setting up cross-department task force to tackle hog disease, which affects Taiwan exports
-- Export orders in February drops 1.7 percent year-on-year
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Seven state-run banks screen loan applications to prevent businessmen from using the fund to invest in China
-- Hog prices tumble in the face of foot and mouth disease outbreak
